programs.title: Here We Go
programs.desc: The series presents the crazy fate of the Jessop family.The everyday life of this family is full of mishaps, misunderstandings and surprising twists.The events are presented from the point of view of Sam - a teenager who almost never leaves his camera and meticulously records his domestic adventures.Each episode brings new problems: failed holidays, risky business ideas, kidnapping of the neighbor's dog, destroyed swimming pool, family quarrels and even an interrupted wedding.Situational humor and brilliant dialogues make it easy to recognize your own family in these imperfect heroes.

programs.desc: In her hometown, Detective Ember Manning (Jenna Coleman) begins to experience a series of terrifying events.The investigator tries to solve their mystery.He checks whether the death of a risk-taking journalist, a fire that broke out on a boat, and an illegal relationship with minors have anything in common.When he seeks the truth, he does not agree to compromise.This time, however, the truth may prove dangerous to her orderly life.He must look at his past differently, understand the complicated present, and see the real face of the city he considers home.
